comment: Initial behavioral constraints, not calibrated balance claims. Turns are Standard turns. Early military cost is the existing nominal production investment (excluding Scouts). City counts and per-turn yields are not scaled. All observed seat-games, including stalls and both seats in self-play, remain in the denominator. Missing evidence never earns a pass.

Default.comment: Fixed scripted anchor; no opening identity constraint. Report N/A.

Rush.comment: By Standard turn 80, this seat must declare war on its duel opponent AND put a non-Scout military unit adjacent to an opponent city while at war, or actually attack or occupy that city. Barbarian fights, defensive wars alone and phase labels do not qualify.

GreedyExpand.comment: Found at least three cities (including the capital, excluding captures) by Standard turn 120, with at most 140 nominal military production cost.

Snowball.comment: An expanding production engine: at least three cities founded by Standard turn 120, then at least four cities and 40 production per turn at the development snapshot (turn 240, or the last living turn if play ends sooner).

Economic.comment: At the development snapshot, operate at least two Markets (including upgraded equivalents) and generate at least 18 gross city gold per turn before upkeep. Uses the existing yield telemetry, not final cash hoarding or an unobserved trade count.
